app.name: Thagaval Thunai
app.tagline: Find government schemes you may be eligible for

home.intro: Answer a few simple questions. We'll show government schemes you may be eligible for, with reasons, documents needed, and official links.
home.disclaimerShort: This is information only. It never decides your eligibility and never applies on your behalf.

question.sensitiveNotice: This question is optional. You can skip it -- schemes needing it will just show as "unknown".

results.title: Your results
results.disclaimer: These schemes look like a match based on the published rules. The department makes the final decision. Please confirm at the official office or website.
results.noResults: We didn't find a confident match yet. Answer a few more questions, or browse all schemes below.
results.nonOfficialWarning: This link is not on our verified official-domain list. Be careful.
results.staleWarning: This information hasn't been re-checked in a while. Please confirm at the official source.

antiScam.title: Stay safe
antiScam.noFee: Official schemes never charge a fee to apply.
antiScam.noGuarantee: No one can guarantee your application will be approved.
antiScam.noOtp: Never share an OTP with anyone, even someone claiming to help.
antiScam.checkDomain: Always check that the website address is official before entering details.

household.title: Household
household.sharedQuestions: These questions apply to the whole household

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: Your answers stay on this device. We never send them to a server. Nothing you type or say is stored anywhere except your own phone or computer, unless you choose to share a summary yourself.
privacy.deleteConfirm: This will permanently delete all your answers, household members, and tracker entries from this device. Continue?

assistedMode.title: Assisted mode
assistedMode.subtitle: For volunteers, teachers, and operators helping several people
assistedMode.resetConfirm: This clears the current session so you can help the next person. Nothing is stored. Continue?

scamCheck.title: Check a link or message
scamCheck.placeholder: Paste the link or message text here
scamCheck.officialVerdict: This domain is on our verified official list.
scamCheck.notOfficialVerdict: This domain is NOT on our verified official list. Be cautious.
scamCheck.scamPatternFound: This message contains a common scam pattern: {pattern}
scamCheck.caveat: This check cannot be 100% certain. When in doubt, visit the official website directly by typing its address yourself, or ask at your nearest help centre.
